name: Witchcrafter Celebration
effectText:
Activate 1 of these effects;
●Destroy 1 "Witchcrafter" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls.
●Fusion Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling Spellcaster monsters from your GY or banishment into the Deck.
During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY and you control a "Witchcrafter" monster: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use 1 "Witchcrafter Celebration" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
